rules-documents.title: Which document?

config.intro: Where does each power or definition come from?

cases.situation: The authority to make Canadian radio regulations comes from…
cases.why: The Act is the root of every other rule.

cases.situation: The authority to publish the amateur Standards (RBR-4) comes from…
cases.why: The Act gives the Minister power to publish standards.

cases.situation: The department that administers the Act is…
options: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
cases.answer: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
cases.why: ISED runs spectrum management in Canada.

cases.situation: The "amateur radio service" is defined in…
cases.why: The Regulations define the services, including amateur radio.

rules-documents.success: Act at the top, Regulations below it, Standards for the details, ISED administering it all.
